Both Medium findings from the previous review passes are now closed, and `.sdlc/runs/20261105-105313-feature-new-text-range-styles/security_review.md` has been updated:

1. **Canonical hex output in `sanitizeStyleColor` and `sanitizeStyleHighlight` (`packages/element/src/textStyles.ts:36-72`)**: Both sanitizers now return the canonical `#rrggbb` / `#rrggbbaa` hex value from `colorToHex(trimmed)` (never the raw string) and compare `baseStrokeColor` via `colorToHex`. All rendering and preview paths (`projectTextRangesOntoLines` in `staticSvgScene.ts` and `renderElement.ts`, `splitTextIntoStyledSegments` in `textWysiwyg.tsx`, `applyTextRangeStyle`, `newTextElement`, and `restoreElement`) normalize ranges before emitting colors, ensuring no `url(...)` or markup can reach SVG `fill` attributes, canvas `fillStyle`, or DOM `style` properties even when `textStyles` is set via `updateScene`.
2. **Pre-iteration `MAX_TEXT_RANGES` bound (`packages/element/src/textStyles.ts:34,197,259,314,372,531,1005`)**: `normalizeTextRanges`, `applyTextRangeStyle`, `getUniformTextRangeStyle`, `shiftTextRangesAtOffset` (and `shiftTextRanges`), `splitTextIntoStyledSegments`, and `projectTextRangesOntoLines` all cap inputs to `MAX_TEXT_RANGES = 2000` before any per-entry iteration.
3. **Out-of-scope note preserved**: The EyeDropper preview interaction in `packages/excalidraw/components/ColorPicker/ColorPicker.tsx` and `packages/excalidraw/components/LayerUI.tsx` remains documented under `## Noted (pre-existing, out of scope)`.
